info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Wholesale Trading Capital Market-spec
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Capital Markets API facilitates the submission and management of capital market transactions in wholesale trading. This API enables financial institutions and traders to efficiently process and manage their trading activities, including order placements and trade executions. Designed for financial services developers, this API supports operations essential for maintaining competitive trading environments. Common users include brokers, investment houses, and other trading entities looking to streamline their capital market interactions.

post.summary: Create a new capital markets entry in wholesale trading.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new entry in the capital markets section of wholesale trading. It provides a streamlined process for adding important data related to capital markets transactions, designed to enhance your trading capabilities and analytics.
